title: A 40-Pound Wolverine Runs 30 mph and Eats Bones

scenes.text: It's the largest land member of the weasel family.
It tops out around 30 miles an hour, even in snow.
Big paws help it move over deep snow.
It eats carcasses whole, bones included.
Small, mean, and built to finish everything.

description:
Wolverines weigh only 25 to 40 pounds, but can run about 30 miles an hour in snow and crush bones.
They scavenge carcasses and eat them bones and all.
Would you want to meet one on a trail?
first_comment: Wolverine or honey badger: who wins?
